# Invoicing Module Implementation

## Goal
Build invoicing functionality into the repo over a series of requests.

## Completed (Request 1)
- Added src/invoices.js with createInvoice({ customerId, issueDate, lines })
- Returns ok(invoice) with:
  - invoice = { customerId, issueDate, status: 'draft', lines }
  - each line enriched with { sku, name, qty, unitPrice, vatRate } from catalogue
- Validates:
  - Customer exists (CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND)
  - Date format and validity (DATE_INVALID for invalid YYYY-MM-DD)
  - Lines array not empty (NO_LINES)
  - Quantity is positive integer (QTY_INVALID)
  - SKU exists in catalogue (UNKNOWN_SKU)
- Added error codes: DATE_INVALID, NO_LINES, QTY_INVALID
- Created comprehensive tests in test/invoices.test.js (14 test cases)
- All 26 tests pass (12 existing + 14 new)

## Completed (Request 2)
- Added lineTotal(line) - calculates qty × unitPrice
- Added invoiceTotals(invoice) - returns { subtotal, total }
  - subtotal = sum of all line totals (in cents)
  - total = subtotal for now (discounts and VAT come later)
- Added 8 comprehensive tests
- All 34 tests pass (26 existing + 8 new)

## Completed (Request 3)
- Added addLine(invoice, { sku, qty })
  - Adds new line at end or increases qty if SKU exists
  - Validates qty and SKU (same as createInvoice)
  - Returns NOT_DRAFT if status isn't 'draft'
  - Never mutates argument
- Added removeLine(invoice, sku)
  - Removes line by SKU
  - Returns LINE_NOT_FOUND if SKU not on invoice
  - Returns NO_LINES if would remove last line
  - Returns NOT_DRAFT if status isn't 'draft'
  - Never mutates argument
- Added error codes: LINE_NOT_FOUND, NOT_DRAFT
- Added 13 comprehensive tests (including chaining test)
- All 47 tests pass (34 existing + 13 new)

## Completed (Request 4)
- Created src/numbering.js with nextInvoiceNumber(existingNumbers, issueDate)
  - Returns format: INV-<year>-<counter> (counter 4-digit zero-padded)
  - Counter resets to 0001 every year
  - Handles out-of-order and malformed numbers gracefully
- Added issueInvoice(invoice, existingNumbers) to src/invoices.js
  - Sets invoice number using nextInvoiceNumber
  - Sets status to 'issued'
  - Returns NOT_DRAFT if invoice not draft
  - Never mutates argument
- Added 9 tests for nextInvoiceNumber (including edge cases)
- Added 5 tests for issueInvoice
- All 61 tests pass (47 existing + 14 new)

## Completed (Request 5)
- Created src/render.js with renderInvoiceText(invoice, customer)
  - Returns plain-text invoice with:
    - First line: invoice number or "DRAFT"
    - Customer name
    - One line per invoice line: qty × name unitPrice lineTotal
    - Last line: Total: amount
  - All amounts formatted with formatEuros() from src/money.js
  - Never mutates arguments
- Added 9 comprehensive tests (formatting, thousands separators, ordering, no mutation)
- All 70 tests pass (61 existing + 9 new)

## Completed (Request 6)
- Added line discounts with optional discountPercent (0-100, decimals allowed)
- createInvoice accepts discountPercent in line input, validates with DISCOUNT_INVALID
- addLine accepts discountPercent in input, validates with DISCOUNT_INVALID
- Added lineDiscount(line) - calculates lineTotal × discountPercent / 100
- Updated invoiceTotals to return { subtotal, discount, total }
  - discount = sum of all line discounts
  - total = subtotal - discount (clamped to 0)
- Project-wide rule: all computed amounts clamped to [0, ∞)
- Added error code: DISCOUNT_INVALID
- Added 13 comprehensive tests (validation, calculation, clamping, decimals)
- All 83 tests pass (70 existing + 13 new)

## Completed (Request 7)
- Added customer tier-based discounts
- Exported TIER_DISCOUNTS from src/customers.js:
  - gold: 5%
  - silver: 2.5%
  - standard: 0%
- createInvoice applies tier discount to lines with no explicit discountPercent
  - Explicit discountPercent (even 0) always wins over tier discount
- Updated createInvoice to accept customer object and apply tier discounts
- Added 8 comprehensive tests (gold/silver/standard, override logic, mixed lines)
- All 91 tests pass (83 existing + 8 new)

## Completed (Request 8)
- Added VAT calculation per line
- Added lineVAT(line) - calculates VAT on taxable amount (lineTotal - lineDiscount) × vatRate / 100, rounded per line
- Updated invoiceTotals to return { subtotal, discount, vat, total }
  - vat = sum of rounded line VATs
  - total = subtotal - discount + vat (clamped to 0)
- Updated renderInvoiceText to show VAT line (just above total) when VAT > 0
- VAT decision: computed per line on amount after discount, rounded per line, never as percentage of invoice total
- Added 12 comprehensive tests (VAT rates 21/9/0, with/without discounts, rounding, rendering)
- All 103 tests pass (91 existing + 12 new)

## Completed (Request 9)
- Added normalizeId(id) to src/customers.js
  - Trims whitespace (leading/trailing)
  - Converts to uppercase
  - Handles mixed case and spaces: ' c-007 ' → 'C-007'
- Updated getCustomer to normalize ID before lookup
- Updated createInvoice to normalize customerId before validation and store normalized ID
- Added 9 comprehensive tests (whitespace, case conversion, mixed input, createInvoice storage)
- All 112 tests pass (103 existing + 9 new)

## Completed (Request 10)
- Created src/dates.js with UTC-based date utilities
  - isValidDate(text) - validates YYYY-MM-DD format and real dates (handles leap years)
  - addDays(date, n) - adds n days to a date string, returns YYYY-MM-DD
  - daysBetween(a, b) - returns b - a in whole days (can be negative)
- All date arithmetic done in UTC, never local timezone

- Created src/payments.js with payment tracking
  - recordPayment(invoice, { amount, date })
    - Records payment on 'issued' or 'partially_paid' invoices
    - Creates payments array on first payment
    - Updates status: 'paid' when fully paid, 'partially_paid' while owed
    - Validates: amount is positive integer, date is valid, no overpayment
    - Returns: ok(newInvoice) or fail with error
  - balanceDue(invoice)
    - Returns total - sum of payments (in cents)
    - Calculates from invoiceTotals and invoice.payments

## Completed (Request 12)
- Added payment terms to createInvoice
  - Accepts optional terms parameter: 'NET14', 'NET30' (default), 'EOM'
  - Sets invoice.terms and invoice.dueDate
  - NET14: due 14 days after issue date
  - NET30: due 30 days after issue date (default)
  - EOM: due on last day of issue date's month (handles Feb 28/29)
- Added calculateDueDate helper function with month/year boundary handling

## Completed (Request 13)
- Added voucher support to invoices
  - applyVoucher(invoice, { code, amount }) applies fixed-amount discount
  - Voucher reduces invoice total AFTER VAT
  - Calculation: total = subtotal - discount + vat - voucher
  - One voucher per invoice (VOUCHER_EXISTS error)
  - Drafts only (NOT_DRAFT error)
  - Amount must be positive integer (AMOUNT_INVALID)
  - Sets invoice.voucher = { code, amount }
- Updated invoiceTotals to include voucher field in returned object
- Voucher amount clamped so total never goes below 0
- Added error code: VOUCHER_EXISTS
- Added 11 comprehensive tests (application, validation, status checks, totals calculation)
- All 170 tests pass (159 existing + 11 new)

## Completed (Request 14)
- Created src/statements.js with statement(customerId, invoices, asOf)
  - Generates customer statements showing outstanding invoices
  - Normalizes customer ID (handles mixed case and spaces)

  - totalDue = sum of all due amounts

content.text:
✅ Done. I've added comprehensive credit note support:

**Created src/credits.js with createCreditNote(invoice, { amount, reason, date }, existingNumbers)**

**Credit note features:**
- Creates refunds on issued invoices
- Accepts invoice status: 'issued', 'partially_paid', or 'paid'
- Returns credit note with:
  - `number`: CN-<year>-<counter> (separate counter from invoices)
  - `invoiceNumber`: references the original invoice
  - `customerId`: from the invoice
  - `amount`: refund amount in cents
  - `reason`: reason for the credit note
  - `date`: credit note issue date in YYYY-MM-DD

**Numbering system:**
- Format: CN-2024-0001, CN-2024-0002, etc.
- Counter resets to 0001 each year
- Separate counter for credit notes vs invoices
- Handles mixed INV-* and CN-* numbers in existingNumbers array

**Validation:**
- NOT_ISSUED: only accepts 'issued', 'partially_paid', or 'paid' invoices
- AMOUNT_INVALID: amount must be positive integer (not 0, negative, or fractional)
- DATE_INVALID: date must be valid YYYY-MM-DD format
- CREDIT_TOO_HIGH: credit note amount cannot exceed invoice total

**Example:**
```javascript
const creditNote = createCreditNote(invoice, {
  amount: 5000,
  reason: 'Damaged goods - replacement shipped',
  date: '2024-10-20'
}, ['INV-2024-0001', 'CN-2024-0001', 'INV-2024-0002'])
// Returns: CN-2024-0002 (second CN for year 2024)
```

**Added 16 tests:**
- Credit note creation for all invoice statuses (issued, partially_paid, paid)
- Validation (non-integer, zero, negative amounts; invalid dates)
- Credit too high validation
- Counter behavior (per-year reset, increments within year)
- Mixed invoice/credit note number handling
- Year boundary handling
- Invoice number preservation

**Test results:** All 201 tests pass ✓

- AMOUNT_INVALID: amount must be positive integer (not 0, negative, or fractional)
- DATE_INVALID: date must be valid YYYY-MM-DD format
- CREDIT_TOO_HIGH: credit note amount cannot exceed invoice total

**Example:**
```javascript
const creditNote = createCreditNote(invoice, {
  amount: 5000,
  reason: 'Damaged goods - replacement shipped',
  date: '2024-10-20'
}, ['INV-2024-0001', 'CN-2024-0001', 'INV-2024-0002'])
// Returns: CN-2024-0002 (second CN for year 2024)
```
